hypothesis: A denser learned edge pool can recover useful second-daughter evidence while source-only threshold selection and add-only geometry gates preserve the strong registered topology.
model: Source-selected scratch seed 314159 checkpoint in each reciprocal direction; detector threshold 0.985; four-view detector TTA unchanged.
edge_pool: Run predict_video once at softmax threshold 0.02, preserving its probability-sorted max-parent/max-child selection; reconstruct stricter candidate pools by filtering probabilities.

source_selection.movies: two source checkpoint-validation movies per direction only
source_selection.eligibility: nonnegative official-score and division-TP deltas versus registered parent
source_selection.choice: highest source-validation official score; ties choose the higher threshold

target_evaluation: Only after source-only selection succeeds, run the selected threshold once on all 12 opposite-embryo movies in each direction; write both outputs before comparison.
promotion_gate: Positive official score in each target embryo and pooled, positive pooled division-TP gain, nonnegative division-TP per embryo, pooled division precision >=0.25, adjusted-edge delta >=-0.005 and no recall loss per embryo, valid degrees.
resource: One RTX6000 job for this project via common queue; 8 CPU, 32 GiB RAM, 8 GiB disk, 120 minutes.
